::: {.context-panel}
“Post-Soviet” describes a shared historical context, not one ethnicity, language, or migration story. The Census Bureau's American Community Survey reports birthplace for foreign-born residents, not ancestry or identity. This dashboard is one small window into Sarasota County's communities; it cannot tell us why anyone moved or how they identify.
:::

```{r}
#| label: prepare-data
#| include: false
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)

birthplace_estimates <- read_csv(
  "data/birthplace_estimates.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

post_soviet_countries <- c(
  "Armenia", "Azerbaijan", "Belarus", "Estonia", "Georgia",
  "Kazakhstan", "Kyrgyzstan", "Latvia", "Lithuania", "Moldova",
  "Russia", "Tajikistan", "Turkmenistan", "Ukraine", "Uzbekistan"
)

region_definitions <- tribble(
  ~region, ~country,
  "Eastern Europe", "Belarus",
  "Eastern Europe", "Moldova",
  "Eastern Europe", "Russia",
  "Eastern Europe", "Ukraine",
  "Central Asia", "Kazakhstan",
  "Central Asia", "Kyrgyzstan",
  "Central Asia", "Tajikistan",
  "Central Asia", "Turkmenistan",
  "Central Asia", "Uzbekistan",
  "Caucasus", "Armenia",
  "Caucasus", "Azerbaijan",
  "Caucasus", "Georgia",
  "Baltics", "Estonia",
  "Baltics", "Latvia",
  "Baltics", "Lithuania"
)

years <- sort(unique(birthplace_estimates$year))
latest_year <- max(years)

country_series <- expand_grid(
  country = post_soviet_countries,
  year = years
) |>
  left_join(birthplace_estimates, by = c("country", "year")) |>
  mutate(series = country)

available_countries <- unique(birthplace_estimates$country)

latest_data <- country_series |>
  filter(year == latest_year, !is.na(estimate)) |>
  arrange(desc(estimate))

if (nrow(latest_data) == 0) {
  stop("No birthplace estimates are available for the latest ACS period.")
}

latest_total <- sum(latest_data$estimate)
latest_total_moe <- sqrt(sum(latest_data$moe^2))
largest_country <- first(latest_data$country)
largest_estimate <- first(latest_data$estimate)
represented_countries <- nrow(latest_data)

regional_series <- country_series |>
  inner_join(region_definitions, by = "country") |>
  mutate(
    has_estimate = !is.na(estimate),
    estimate_for_region = coalesce(estimate, 0),
    moe_for_region = coalesce(moe, 0)
  ) |>
  group_by(region, year) |>
  summarise(
    estimate = if (any(has_estimate)) {
      sum(estimate_for_region)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    moe = if (any(has_estimate)) {
      sqrt(sum(moe_for_region^2))
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    reported = sum(has_estimate),
    members = n(),
    included_countries = paste(country[has_estimate], collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

regional_latest <- regional_series |>
  filter(year == latest_year) |>
  arrange(match(region, c("Eastern Europe", "Central Asia", "Caucasus", "Baltics")))

change_data <- country_series |>
  filter(!is.na(estimate)) |>
  arrange(country, year) |>
  group_by(country) |>
  summarise(
    first_year = first(year),
    last_year = last(year),
    first_estimate = first(estimate),
    last_estimate = last(estimate),
    first_moe = first(moe),
    last_moe = last(moe),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(first_year < last_year) |>
  mutate(
    change = last_estimate - first_estimate,
    change_moe = sqrt(first_moe^2 + last_moe^2),
    change_text = paste0(
      "<b>", country, "</b><br>",
      first_year, " estimate: ", scales::comma(first_estimate),
      " (±", scales::comma(first_moe), ")<br>",
      last_year, " estimate: ", scales::comma(last_estimate),
      " (±", scales::comma(last_moe), ")<br>",
      "Estimated change: ", scales::comma(change),
      "<br>Approximate change MOE: ±", scales::comma(change_moe)
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(abs(change)))

country_plot <- plot_ly(height = 530)
initial_countries <- c("Ukraine", "Russia", "Lithuania")

for (country_name in post_soviet_countries) {
  series_data <- country_series |>
    filter(country == country_name)

  hover_text <- ifelse(
    is.na(series_data$estimate),
    paste0(
      "<b>", country_name, "</b><br>",
      "ACS period ending: ", series_data$year, "<br>",
      "No separate estimate reported"
    ),
    paste0(
      "<b>", country_name, "</b><br>",
      "ACS period ending: ", series_data$year, "<br>",
      "Estimated residents: ", scales::comma(series_data$estimate), "<br>",
      "Margin of error: ±", scales::comma(series_data$moe)
    )
  )

  country_plot <- add_trace(
    country_plot,
    data = series_data,
    x = ~year,
    y = ~estimate,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "lines+markers",
    name = country_name,
    text = hover_text,
    hovertemplate = "%{text}<extra></extra>",
    showlegend = any(!is.na(series_data$estimate)),
    error_y = list(
      type = "data",
      array = series_data$moe,
      visible = TRUE
    ),
    visible = if (country_name %in% initial_countries) TRUE else "legendonly"
  )
}

country_plot <- country_plot |>
  layout(
    title = "Estimated residents by birthplace",
    xaxis = list(
      title = "ACS five-year period ending",
      tickmode = "array",
      tickvals = years
    ),
    yaxis = list(title = "Estimated residents", separatethousands = TRUE),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "Country of birth")),
    margin = list(b = 100)
  ) |>
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE, responsive = TRUE) |>
  htmlwidgets::onRender(
    "function(el, x) {
      var selector = document.getElementById('birthplace-series');
      var status = document.getElementById('birthplace-status');
      var errorButton = document.getElementById('birthplace-errors');
      var allCountriesButton = document.getElementById('birthplace-all-countries');
      var initial = ['Ukraine', 'Russia', 'Lithuania'];
      var current = initial.slice();
      var savedSelection = initial.slice();
      var allCountryNames = Array.from(selector.options)
        .map(function(option) { return option.value; });
      var showingAllCountries = false;
      var showErrors = true;

      Array.from(selector.options).forEach(function(option) {
        option.selected = initial.includes(option.value);
      });

      function updateStatus(message) {
        status.textContent = message;
      }

      function updateAllCountriesStatus() {
        var visibleCountries = el.data.filter(function(trace) {
          return allCountryNames.includes(trace.name) &&
            trace.visible !== 'legendonly' && trace.visible !== false;
        }).length;
        updateStatus('Showing ' + visibleCountries + ' reported countries.');
      }

      function syncSelector() {
        current = el.data
          .filter(function(trace) {
            return trace.visible !== 'legendonly' && trace.visible !== false;
          })
          .map(function(trace) { return trace.name; });
        Array.from(selector.options).forEach(function(option) {
          option.selected = current.includes(option.value);
        });
        updateStatus('Showing ' + current.length + ' of 3 allowed selections.');
      }

      selector.addEventListener('change', function() {
        var selected = Array.from(selector.selectedOptions)
          .map(function(option) { return option.value; });
        if (selected.length > 3) {
          Array.from(selector.options).forEach(function(option) {
            option.selected = current.includes(option.value);
          });
          updateStatus('Choose no more than three countries.');
          return;
        }
        current = selected;
        Plotly.restyle(el, {
          visible: el.data.map(function(trace) {
            return selected.includes(trace.name) ? true : 'legendonly';
          })
        });
        updateStatus('Showing ' + selected.length + ' of 3 allowed selections.');
      });

      errorButton.addEventListener('click', function() {
        showErrors = !showErrors;
        Plotly.restyle(el, {'error_y.visible': showErrors});
        errorButton.textContent = showErrors ? 'Hide error bars' : 'Show error bars';
      });

      el.on('plotly_legendclick', function(event) {
        var trace = el.data[event.curveNumber];
        var isVisible = trace.visible !== 'legendonly' && trace.visible !== false;
        var visibleCount = el.data.filter(function(item) {
          return item.visible !== 'legendonly' && item.visible !== false;
        }).length;
        if (!showingAllCountries && !isVisible && visibleCount >= 3) {
          updateStatus('Choose no more than three countries.');
          return false;
        }
        setTimeout(showingAllCountries ? updateAllCountriesStatus : syncSelector, 0);
      });

      allCountriesButton.addEventListener('click', function() {
        if (showingAllCountries) {
          showingAllCountries = false;
          selector.disabled = false;
          allCountriesButton.textContent = 'Show all reported countries';
          current = savedSelection.slice();
          Array.from(selector.options).forEach(function(option) {
            option.selected = current.includes(option.value);
          });
          Plotly.restyle(el, {
            visible: el.data.map(function(trace) {
              return current.includes(trace.name) ? true : 'legendonly';
            })
          });
          updateStatus('Showing ' + current.length + ' of 3 allowed selections.');
          return;
        }

        savedSelection = current.slice();
        showingAllCountries = true;
        selector.disabled = true;
        allCountriesButton.textContent = 'Show selected countries';
        Array.from(selector.options).forEach(function(option) {
          option.selected = !option.disabled;
        });
        Plotly.restyle(el, {
          visible: el.data.map(function(trace) {
            return allCountryNames.includes(trace.name) ? true : 'legendonly';
          })
        });
        updateAllCountriesStatus();
      });

      updateStatus('Showing ' + current.length + ' of 3 allowed selections.');
    }"
  )

regional_plot <- plot_ly(height = 420)

for (region_name in regional_latest$region) {
  region_data <- regional_series |>
    filter(region == region_name) |>
    arrange(year)

  region_hover <- paste0(
    "<b>", region_name, "</b><br>",
    "ACS period ending: ", region_data$year, "<br>",
    "Reported countries: ", region_data$reported, " of ", region_data$members,
    "<br>Estimated residents: ", scales::comma(region_data$estimate),
    "<br>Approximate margin of error: ±", scales::comma(region_data$moe)
  )

  regional_plot <- add_trace(
    regional_plot,
    data = region_data,
    x = ~year,
    y = ~estimate,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "lines+markers",
    name = region_name,
    text = region_hover,
    hovertemplate = "%{text}<extra></extra>",
    error_y = list(type = "data", array = region_data$moe, visible = TRUE)
  )
}

regional_plot <- regional_plot |>
  layout(
    title = "Reported birthplace estimates by region",
    xaxis = list(title = "ACS five-year period ending", tickvals = years),
    yaxis = list(title = "Estimated residents", separatethousands = TRUE),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "Project-defined region")),
    margin = list(b = 80)
  ) |>
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE, responsive = TRUE)

change_plot <- plot_ly(
  data = change_data,
  x = ~change,
  y = ~reorder(country, abs(change)),
  type = "bar",
  orientation = "h",
  text = ~change_text,
  hovertemplate = "%{text}<extra></extra>",
  marker = list(
    color = ifelse(change_data$change >= 0, "#168b85", "#d27a55")
  ),
  error_x = list(
    type = "data",
    array = change_data$change_moe,
    visible = TRUE
  ),
  height = 510
) |>
  layout(
    title = "Change between each country's first and latest reported periods",
    xaxis = list(title = "Estimated change in residents", zeroline = TRUE),
    yaxis = list(title = "Country of birth"),
    showlegend = FALSE,
    margin = list(l = 120)
  ) |>
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE, responsive = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: summary-cards
#| echo: false
#| message: false

htmltools::div(
  class = "metric-grid",
  htmltools::div(
    class = "metric-card",
    htmltools::span(class = "metric-label", "Foreign-born population"),
    htmltools::strong(scales::comma(latest_total)),
    htmltools::span(
      class = "metric-note",
      paste0(
        "Sum of ", represented_countries, " reported estimates in ",
        latest_year, " · approx. ±", scales::comma(latest_total_moe)
      )
    )
  ),
  htmltools::div(
    class = "metric-card",
    htmltools::span(class = "metric-label", "Birthplaces represented"),
    htmltools::strong(paste(represented_countries, "of 15")),
    htmltools::span(class = "metric-note", paste("Separate estimates in", latest_year))
  ),
  htmltools::div(
    class = "metric-card",
    htmltools::span(class = "metric-label", "Largest reported birthplace"),
    htmltools::strong(largest_country),
    htmltools::span(
      class = "metric-note",
      paste(scales::comma(largest_estimate), "estimated residents")
    )
  ),
  htmltools::div(
    class = "metric-card metric-card-accent",
    htmltools::span(class = "metric-label", "Most recent ACS period"),
    htmltools::strong(latest_year),
    htmltools::span(class = "metric-note", "Five-year estimate ending in this year")
  )
)
```

## Birthplace estimates over time

Choose up to three republics in the list, or use the legend. Azerbaijan and Georgia have separate estimates starting in 2022; Estonia, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, and Turkmenistan are not separately reported. Unavailable countries remain listed but disabled. Missing estimates are never treated as zero. Neighboring ACS five-year periods overlap.

```{r}
#| label: birthplace-chart
#| echo: false
#| message: false

htmltools::tagList(
  htmltools::div(
    class = "chart-controls",
    htmltools::tags$label(
      `for` = "birthplace-series",
      "Choose up to three countries (Ctrl/Cmd-click to select multiple):"
    ),
    htmltools::tags$select(
      id = "birthplace-series",
      multiple = "multiple",
      size = "7",
      lapply(post_soviet_countries, \(country) {
      if (country %in% available_countries) {
        htmltools::tags$option(value = country, country)
      } else {
        htmltools::tags$option(
          value = country,
          disabled = "disabled",
          paste(country, "(not separately reported)")
        )
      }
      })
    ),
    htmltools::tags$button(
      id = "birthplace-all-countries",
      type = "button",
      "Show all reported countries"
    ),
    htmltools::tags$button(
      id = "birthplace-errors",
      type = "button",
      "Hide error bars"
    ),
    htmltools::tags$p(
      id = "birthplace-status",
      role = "status",
      "Showing 3 of 3 allowed selections."
    )
  ),
  country_plot
)
```

## Regional comparison

Regions are project-defined groupings, not Census categories. The chart adds only countries with separate birthplace estimates in each period; coverage in the hover text makes partial totals visible. Older estimates therefore may cover fewer countries than newer ones.

```{r}
#| label: regional-chart
#| echo: false
#| message: false

regional_plot
```

| Project-defined region | Included republics |
|:--|:--|
| Eastern Europe | Belarus, Moldova, Russia, Ukraine |
| Central Asia | Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, Uzbekistan |
| Caucasus | Armenia, Azerbaijan, Georgia |
| Baltics | Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania |

Regional margins of error are approximate combinations of the reported country margins; see [About](about.qmd) for details.

## Estimated population change

The chart compares each country's earliest and latest available estimate. Bars show estimated change; whiskers show an approximate margin of error for the difference. Changes within or near the whiskers are especially uncertain. Even changes outside them are not definitive significance tests because ACS five-year periods overlap.

```{r}
#| label: change-chart
#| echo: false
#| message: false

change_plot
```
